metadata.title: गुदाई: बैगा आदिवासी की पहचान | The Sacred Tattoo Art of the Baiga Tribe
metadata.description:
In this episode of Main Bhi Bharat, we journey deep into the forests of central India to explore the ancient and sacred tattoo traditions of the Baiga tribe. Known for their rich cultural heritage and deep connection with nature, the Baigas express their identity, spirituality, and life experiences through intricate tattoo art — a practice passed down through generations.

Through powerful visuals and intimate conversations with Baiga women, we uncover the meanings behind these symbolic tattoos, the rituals involved in the process, and how the community continues to preserve this unique tradition in the face of modernisation. More than body art, these tattoos are a living language that speaks of belonging, protection, and pride.

Join us as we delve into this mesmerising form of tribal expression and celebrate the resilience of a community that wears its story on its skin.
